# Vane

Vane is a personalized weather app for iPhone. It learns how different weather conditions feel to an individual and adds that personal context to a full weather forecast.

Official website: https://vane.codearc.studio/

## Main pages

- Home: https://vane.codearc.studio/
- Contact: https://vane.codearc.studio/contact/
- Privacy Policy: https://vane.codearc.studio/privacy/
- Terms of Use: https://vane.codearc.studio/terms/

## Product

Vane includes Sense, a personalization system that learns from simple weather check-ins over time. Vane still provides standard forecast details such as temperature, rain, wind, humidity, UV, sunrise, and sunset.

## Public beta

The Vane public iPhone beta is available through TestFlight:
https://testflight.apple.com/join/GHEW2GvN
